P.name: Stone Skin
P.title: Template:Data Wukong/Stone Skin
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1|Ability data}}}|Stone Skin|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}} |champion = Wukong |skill = I |icon = Stone Skin.png |blurb = {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Wukong}} gains {{as|{{sti|'''bonus''' armor}}|armor}} based on level and {{as|{{sti|health regeneration}}}} equal to a portion of {{as|his '''maximum''' health}}. |blurb2 = Whenever '''Wukong''' or his ''{{ai|Warrior Trickster|Wukong|clone}}'' damage an enemy {{tip|champion}} or {{tip|monster}}, he generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Strength of Stone'', which stacks up to 5 times. |blurb4 = {{sbc|Strength of Stone:}} For each stack, '''Wukong''' increases the {{as|'''bonus''' armor}} and {{as|{{sti|health regeneration}}}} gained. |description = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Wukong''' gains {{sti|armor|{{as|{{pp|6 + (10-6)/17*(x-1) for 20}} '''bonus''' armor}}|armor}} and {{as|{{sti|health regeneration|regenerates}}}} an additional{{ft|{{as|{{fd|0.35}}% of his {{sti|'''maximum''' health}}}} every 5 seconds.|{{as|{{fd|{{ap|0.35/10}}}}% of his {{sti|'''maximum''' health}}}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds.}}

Whenever '''Wukong''' or his ''{{ai|Warrior Trickster|Wukong|clone}}'' damage an enemy {{tip|champion}} or {{tip|monster}} with his {{tip|basic attacks}} or {{tip|abilities}}, he generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Strength of Stone'' for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits and stacking up to 5 times. Stacks expire one by one every second when the duration ends. |description2 = {{sbc|Strength of Stone:}} For each stack,{{ft|''Stone Skin's'' effects are increased by 100%,|'''Wukong''' gains {{as|{{pp|6 to 10}} '''additional bonus''' armor|armor}} and further regenerates an additional {{as|{{fd|0.35}}% of his '''maximum''' health}} every 5 seconds,}}up to a maximum of {{as|{{pp|6*(1+1*5) + (10*(1+1*5)-6*(1+1*5))/17*(x-1) for 20}} '''bonus''' armor}} and total additional regeneration of{{ft|{{as|{{ap|0.35*6}}% '''maximum''' health}} every 5 seconds.|{{as|{{ap|0.35*6/10}}% '''maximum''' health}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds.}} |targeting = Passive |affects = Self |damagetype = |spelleffects = |onhiteffects = |spellshield = True |parry = True |notes = * Stacks of ''Strength of Stone'' are also granted {{tip|on-hit}}, but will specifically not be if the target is {{tip|invulnerable}}. }}

Q.name: Crushing Blow
Q.title: Template:Data Wukong/Crushing Blow
Q.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Crushing Blow|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Wukong
|skill        = Q
|icon         = Crushing Blow.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{cis|Wukong}} next basic attack within a few seconds will gain {{sti|range|'''bonus''' range}}, deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}, and inflict {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|armor reduction}}}} for a short time.
|blurb2      = The cooldown is {{sti|cdr|reduced}} whenever '''Wukong''' or his ''{{ai|Warrior Trickster|Wukong|clone}}'' damage an enemy.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Wukong''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} within 5 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|range|'''bonus''' range}}, deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and then inflict {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|armor reduction}}}} for 3 seconds.
|leveling     = {{st|Bonus Range|{{ap|135 to 175}}}}
{{st|Bonus Physical Damage|{{ap|20 to 120}} {{as|(+ 50% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Armor Reduction|{{as|{{ap|10 to 30}}% of target's armor}}}}
|description2 = ''Crushing Blow's'' {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced by {{fd|0.5}} seconds whenever '''Wukong''' or his ''{{ai|Warrior Trickster|Wukong|clone}}'' damage an enemy.
|description3 = ''Crushing Blow {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Wukong's''' and his {{ai|Warrior Trickster|Wukong|clone's}} basic attack timer. Other abilities can be used during the attack's animation.''
|cooldown     = {{ap|8 to 6}}
|cdstart      = post-effect
|cost         = 20
|costtype     = Mana
|cast time    = none
|queue time   = {{fd|0.2}}
|targeting    = Auto
|affects      = Self, Enemies
|damagetype   = Physical
|spelleffects = special
|parry = true
|spellshield  = True
|notes        = 
* The {{tip|basic attack}} portion of ''Crushing Blow'' is tagged as both {{tip|basic damage}} and {{tip|spell damage}}, while the bonus damage portion is {{tip|proc damage}}.
* ''Crushing Blow'' triggers on {{tip|turret|structures}} and {{tip|ward|wards}} but the armor reduction is not applied.
* Issuing a Hold command (default {{sbc|J}}) or Stop command (default {{sbc|S}}) after ''Crushing Blow's'' attack has started will cancel the animation, however the attack will still be launched and '''Wukong''' will be unable to move until that point.
|yvideo       = nX5I7jY_zSY
}}

W.name: Warrior Trickster
W.title: Template:Data Wukong/Warrior Trickster
W.wikitext:
<!-- The following values are defined as parameters
-->{{#vardefine:cd_1|40}}<!--Clone Rank 1 outgoing damage
-->{{#vardefine:cd_5|60}}<!--Clone Rank 5 outgoing damage
-->{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Warrior Trickster|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Wukong
|skill        = W
|icon         = Warrior Trickster.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Wukong}} enters brief {{tip|invisibility}} and {{tip|dash|dashes}} to the target location, leaving behind a {{tip|clone}} for a short time.
|blurb2       = The clone can attack autonomously and gains the effects of his other abilities, as well as casts ''{{ai|Cyclone|Wukong}}'' when '''Wukong''' does.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Wukong''' enters {{tip|invisibility}} for 1 second and {{tip|dash|dashes}} in the target direction, leaving behind a {{tip|clone}} of himself at his casting position for 4 seconds.
|description2 = The clone is {{tip|untargetable}} to allies and can basic attack autonomously, prioritizing the last enemy '''Wukong''' damaged. It can also gain the effects of ''{{ai|Crushing Blow|Wukong}}'' and ''{{ais|Nimbus Strike|Wukong}}'' {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}, and casts ''{{ai|Cyclone|Wukong}}'' whenever '''Wukong''' does.
|description3 = The clone deals reduced damage.
|leveling3    = {{st|Clone Outgoing Damage|{{ap|{{#var:cd_1}} to {{#var:cd_5}}}}%}}
|description4 = ''See [[Wukong#Pets|Pets]] for more details about '''Wukong's''' clone. '''Wukong''' can cast any of his [[champion ability|abilities]] during the dash.''
|cooldown     = {{ap|22 to 18}}
|cdstart      = on-cast
|cost         = {{ap|60 to 40}}
|costtype     = Mana
|target range = {{tt|100 - 300|Minimum and maximum dash distance}}
|cast time    = none
|speed        = {{tt|900|Dash speed}}
|queue time   = {{fd|0.3}}
|targeting    = Location
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = physical
|spelleffects = special
|parry        = true
|grounded     = true
|knockdown    = true
|onhiteffects = 
|spellshield  = True
|outofrange   = cast at max
|notes        = 
* Casting ''Warrior Trickster'' during an ability's effects will transfer them to the clone.
* {{tip|Turret}} shots instantly kill the clone.
* The clone is immune to {{tip|stasis}} and {{ui|Blast Cone}}.
* The clone can still be targeted by allied {{tip|auto-targeted}} effects (e.g. {{si|Heal}}, {{ai|Celestial Blessing|Kayle}}).
* Using a basic attack breaks the stealth at the end of the attack windup.
|tips = 
* Issuing a Hold (default {{sbc|J}}), Stop (default {{sbc|S}}) or Toggle (default {{sbc|Ctrl + 5}}) command will play '''Wukong's''' idle animation, which is the same animation that plays for his clone upon spawning. This can effectively cause enemies to mistake '''Wukong''' for his clone (as vice versa) for a short duration.
}}

R.name: Cyclone
R.title: Template:Data Wukong/Cyclone
R.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Cyclone|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Wukong
|skill        = R
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Wukong}} spins his staff around for a short time, becoming {{tip|ghosted}} and gaining {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}. The staff continually deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit based on {{as|their '''maximum''' health}}, and can briefly {{tip|airborne|knock them up}} once.
|blurb2       = ''Cyclone'' can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards.
|blurb3       = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Wukong''' ends ''Cyclone''. He cast ''Cyclone'' a second time within a period after the first cast has ended.
|icon         = Cyclone.png
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Wukong''' spins his staff around for up to 2 seconds, becoming {{tip|ghosted}} and gaining {{sti|ms|{{as|20% '''bonus''' movement speed|ms}}}}. The staff deals {{as|physical damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds to enemies hit, and can {{tip|airborne|knock them up}} once for {{fd|0.6}} seconds. ''Cyclone'' will not {{tip|airborne|knock up}} enemies who were already hit by either '''Wukong''' or his ''{{ai|Warrior Trickster|Wukong|clone}}'' within the same cast.
|leveling     = {{st|Physical Damage Per Tick|{{as|{{ap|8/8 to 16/8}}% of target's '''maximum''' health}} {{as|(+ {{ap|275/8}}% AD)}}|Total Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|8 to 16}}% of target's '''maximum''' health}} {{as|(+ 275% AD)}}}}
|description2 = ''Cyclone'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards or by casting another {{tip|ability}}. 
|icon3        = Cyclone 2.png
|description3 = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Wukong''' ends ''Cyclone''. After 1 second, he can cast ''Cyclone'' a second time within 8 seconds of the first cast.
|leveling3    = {{st|Maximum Total Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|8*2 to 16*2}}% of target's '''maximum''' health}} {{as|(+ {{ap|275*2}}% AD)}}}}
|description4 = ''{{ais|Nimbus Strike|Wukong}}'' {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}} duration is continuously refreshed while spinning.
|description5 = ''Cyclone's'' damage is capped at {{pp|200 to 600 for 3|6;11;16}} per second against {{tip|monsters}}.
|effect radius= {{tip|cr|icononly=true}} 315
|cooldown     = {{ap|130 to 90}}
|cdstart      = post-effect
|cast time    = none
|cost         = 100
|costtype     = Mana
|queue time   = {{tt|{{fd|0.3}}|Initial cast}}
|targeting    = Auto
|affects      = Enemies, Self
|damagetype   = physical
|spelleffects = aoedot
|spellshield  = Special
|notes        = 
* ''Cyclone'' is special cased to grant stacks of {{ri|Conqueror}} for each tick of damage.
* Casting a basic ability will always interrupt '''Wukong's''' ''Cyclone''. A clone can be interrupted by casting {{ai|Crushing Blow|Wukong}}, but only if the clone was made during the current ''Cyclone'' cast and only for that cast. This means if both '''Wukong''' and his clone are spinning, the clone cannot be interrupted.
* ''Cyclone's'' remaining duration always stays the same even after the clone replicated the ability.
* During ''Cyclone'', '''Wukong''' and his clone's {{sti|attack ranges|link=range}} are reduced{{ft|to 50|by 125}}.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block one instance of damage.
** Blocking the {{tip|airborne|knock up}} will still grant immunity to it from either of ''Cyclone's'' casts.
{{ct|attack=false|move=true|cast=Other abilities are disabled for the first {{fd|0.3}} seconds, casting them afterwards interrupts.|items=true|consume=true|spells=true,true,true,false,true|interrupts=death}}
|yvideo       = nFOxrFoG_DQ
}}
